These data were obtained by retrieving pharmacological interventions for people with cSVD from six clinical trial registries (Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry, Japan Registry of Clinical Trials, ISRCTN Registry, EU Clinical Trials Register, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Chinese Clinical Trial Register) as of 27/OCT/2025. Trials were identified using free text searches with the terms "small vessel disease" OR "SVD" OR "cerebral amyloid angiopathy" OR "CAA" OR "vascular dementia". We included trials recruiting people with sporadic or monogenic SVD defined by neuroradiological criteria or clinical syndromes. Trials recruiting people with ICH or dementia were included only if an SVD-related aetiology was specified as an inclusion criterion (e.g., ICH with evidence of CAA). To provide an overview of current drug development efforts, we excluded trials comparing clinical management strategies (e.g., intensive versus standard blood pressure targets) and those testing herbal medicines without a specific molecular target or mechanism of action. Phase IV trials were excluded. Trial phase classifications were obtained from registry records. For each drug, molecular targets were retrieved from ChEMBL (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/) or, when unavailable, inferred from the known mechanism of action. Target-related UniProt entries (https://www.uniprot.org/) were queried in Open Targets (https://platform.opentargets.org/) to extract genetic evidence supporting target-phenotype associations. Duplicate trial names have factorial designs (testing multiple drugs).
